list: the official 55 trophies, as listed 18-19 November 2026
notes: Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's official text as listed by the trophy trackers. Every guide below is written for this entry in its own words; each cites the published source its facts come from. Where launch-week sources say no method is confirmed yet, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.guide: This is the last trophy you'll earn: it unlocks automatically once the other 54 are all checked off. Budget roughly 200 hours for the complete run, with the bulk of that time going to the 100% completion grind instead of any single difficult trophy. Take the roadmap stage by stage — main story first, saving by hand at each chapter; side strands after that; the long grinds to finish — and the Platinum will take care of itself.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Work through roadmap stages 1–6 first; this trophy needs no separate effort.
Save by hand at the start of each chapter — missions can't be replayed.
Stay away from cheats on your trophy save, since they're expected to disable trophies.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end and it pops. It is the first mission of the game, so there is nothing to prepare and nothing to miss — just finish it.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play through the opening mission Gone Fishing.

trophies.guide: You can't miss this one: it unlocks when the final Chapter 1 main mission is done. The pop sometimes waits until the next chapter begins instead of triggering on the closing cutscene, so a short delay is normal. One thing to handle before moving on, though — Lucia's balcony meditation is the chapter's only missable task (details under Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Clear every main mission in Chapter 1.
Complete Lucia's balcony meditation for Positive Mental Attitude before the chapter closes.
Hold on to a hand-made save from the beginning of Chapter 1.

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish every main mission in Chapter 2. This is the chapter where switching between Jason and Lucia opens up, which unlocks the partner trophies (Hot Together, Retail Therapy, Personal Best). While you are here, rob Kingpin Bowling for Let's Go Bowling and start the side strands.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Play all Chapter 2 main missions.
Once character switching opens, try the partner activities.
Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 2.

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish every main mission in Chapter 3. This chapter opens the jewelry-store robberies (the Snap Gun comes from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs) and holds the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Yago's street-racing strand — do that race the moment it appears, with a save first, because the strand counts toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Play all Chapter 3 main missions.
Do Race Against Yago as soon as it appears (time-sensitive).
Keep a manual save from the start of Chapter 3.

trophies.guide: Another story trophy that unlocks on its own: complete all of Chapter 4's main missions. Before the finale, make time for That's Where The Money Is — an optional side mission that opens the bank-vault jobs Maximum Withdrawal depends on. Also keep one pristine hand-made save from right before the final mission.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Clear every main mission in Chapter 4.
Run the optional That's Where The Money Is to unlock bank vaults.
Hold a clean save from right before the final mission — don't overwrite it.

trophies.guide: A gold that unlocks on its own once the final mission is finished. Launch has neither mission replay nor New Game Plus, so hold one clean hand-made save from just before the finale — it's your fallback for anything you'd like to redo. After the credits roll, everything beyond the story remains open, so all the cleanup trophies can wait until this one is done.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Play the final mission through to its end.
Hold a clean hand-made save from just before the final mission.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission Breakfast Run when it comes up in the story. No special preparation is needed; it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission The Cartel Heist when it comes up in the story. It is one of the bigger set-piece missions; finishing it is all the trophy asks.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission Child's Play when it comes up in the story. It pops at the end of the mission, with nothing extra to do.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Complete the story mission Child's Play.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission Headliners when it comes up in the story. Finish the mission and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Complete the story mission Headliners.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission VCIA Takedown when it comes up in the story. The airport setting is worth remembering later — Catch Me If You Can also plays out at VCIA, but that one is a separate free-roam trophy.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: complete the mission Operation Savage Glory when it comes up in the story. Finish the mission and it pops.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.guide: This is the marathon trophy: full 100% completion. You'll only see the checklist once the story is finished, at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion — but anything you complete beforehand still counts toward it, so start chipping away early. The list holds 35 tasks, and the headline targets are 300 stunts (beyond the 250 Cunning Stunts asks for), 200 of the 277 vehicle models, 70 out of 80 Challenges, every one of the 8 bank vaults, plus all 39 illegal operations. The bulk of the roughly 200-hour Platinum estimate is spent here.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Complete the story; the checklist then shows under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Drive stunts to 300, Challenges to 70, and discovered vehicles to 200.
Finish all 8 bank vaults plus all 39 illegal operations.
Work through the rest of the checklist tasks one at a time after the credits.

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts: stunt jumps, flying under bridges, knife flights and base jumps all count toward the total. Stunts are cumulative across the whole game, so the count builds naturally while you play — but don't stop at 250, because A Long Road needs 300 for 100% completion. Keep stunt-jumping whenever you pass a ramp or a bridge and the number climbs on its own.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Do stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps.
Keep going to 300 stunts for the 100% checklist.

citation.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type once — the list tracks 9 types. This is a sampler, not a grind: one go at each activity (fishing, shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, gym training, racing and hunting are the kinds the list's other trophies point at) is enough. If it hasn't popped, check which activity you have never touched and try that one.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try one of each activity type: fishing, shooting range, drone race, arcade, bowling, meditation, gym, racing, hunting.
The trophy pops once every type has been tried at least once.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across two shooting ranges. This is one of the three trophies launch-week guides call the toughest, because gold medals demand accuracy under time pressure rather than just participation. Work through the challenges weapon by weapon, replay any you miss, and treat it as a skill grind to do in short sessions rather than one long sitting.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit both shooting ranges and work through their challenges.
Gold-medal all 42 challenges; replay any that fall short.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Take a Top Fun drone race victory at each of the 14 locations. A single win at a spot is enough — there's no need to win every race there — so head to the next location once you've won one. These races test your flying: study each course's racing line, shave corners where the gates permit it, and keep retrying the tricky courses until a win comes.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Track down every Top Fun drone race location — there are 14 of them.
Score at least one win at each location.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race don't count, so variety is the point. Race across the state's street, off-road and circuit events, and keep an eye on which ones you've already won. Yago's street-racing strand feeds both this trophy and Strangers & Freaks, so run it early (and do the time-sensitive Race Against Yago the moment it appears).
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Win races across different events; each distinct race counts once.
Run Yago's street-racing strand early for double progress.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the earliest activities to open up, and launch-week checklists put this one in Chapter 1 — take the challenge when it appears rather than leaving it. Out-fish Cal and the trophy is yours.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Take up fishing when the activity opens in Chapter 1.
Accept Cal's fishing challenge and beat him.

trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game from start to finish. Any arcade cabinet counts — pick the game you find easiest and play it through. Launch-week checklists put this in Chapter 1, so knock it out early while you're near an arcade.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade cabinet and play one game through to completion.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's questline by completing his final mission. Andy's strand is Lucia-only, so play it as her. Like the other side-story finales, it stays available after the credits, so there is no rush — but note that Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, since it has its own trophy.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Play Andy's questline as Lucia.
Complete Andy's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline by completing his final mission. Kenton's strand stays open after the story ends, so you can do it during the post-story cleanup. Work through his missions in order until the finale unlocks.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Work through Kenton's questline.
Complete Kenton's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's questline by completing his final mission. Billy's strand stays open after the credits. Note that Billy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks — it has its own trophy, so don't expect the counter to move when you finish it.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Work through Billy's questline.
Complete Billy's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands around Leonida. Some optional questlines don't count toward the total — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's each have a trophy of their own, so they won't budge this counter; verify the trophy's progress tally after finishing each strand. Watch for one time-sensitive strand: Race Against Yago, part of Yago's street-racing strand in Chapter 3, shows an hourglass icon — save beforehand and take the race the instant it shows up.
trophies.missableNote: Time-sensitive: Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 (hourglass icon) — do it as soon as it appears.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Finish 8 stranger strands, verifying the trophy counter after each.
Strands for Andy, Billy and Tyrone do NOT count toward this trophy.
Race Against Yago the instant it appears in Chapter 3 — it's time-sensitive.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's questline by completing his final mission. Randy's strand stays open after the story ends, so it fits the post-story cleanup. Work through his missions in order until the finale unlocks.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Work through Randy's questline.
Complete Randy's final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline by completing his final mission. Tyrone's strand is Jason-only, so play it as him. It stays open after the credits, and like Andy's and Billy's it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Play Tyrone's questline as Jason.
Complete Tyrone's final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Hit every meditation spot in Leonida — 18 spots in total — and note this is the trophy launch-week guides single out as potentially missable. The danger point is Lucia's balcony meditation during Chapter 1: once Lucia is back home, look in the kitchen in the morning (typically the morning following the Down to Earth mission) and she'll step onto Jason's balcony for her meditation. Trail her there and take the optional task, because it vanishes when Chapter 1 closes. Spots appear as purple icons when you're nearby, and meditating at each outdoor spot with both characters should count it twice — so always bring your partner along. Hang on to a Chapter 1 save until this one pops.
trophies.missableNote: THE missable trophy: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears after the chapter. No mission replay — keep a Chapter 1 save.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: In Chapter 1, complete Lucia's balcony meditation before the chapter closes (check the kitchen in the morning).
Visit every spot — purple icons when nearby — with your partner along so each counts twice.
Keep a Chapter 1 hand-made save until the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bag a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His hunting questline can only be played as Jason, and it sends you after its targets via target decks. Go for a clean head or heart shot — the hunt is graded on how pristine the carcass stays. The strand remains available once the story is over, making it a good fit for post-story cleanup.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Run Bret's hunting questline as Jason.
Follow the target deck to the unique animal, then land a clean head or heart shot.

citation.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida as a collectible hunt — pick them up as you explore and the sets fill in over time. Since only 3 sets are needed, focus on the sets you are closest to finishing rather than chasing every card in the state at once.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Collect cards across Leonida as you explore.
Complete any 3 full card sets.

citation.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app's 'WAiNK It' feature at 100 different locations. WAiNK is the in-game social app, and 'WAiNK It' is its check-in at a place — so the trophy is really a tour of Leonida with your phone out. Do it as you explore for The Goodtime State and the two trophies progress together.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Open the WAiNK app at locations across Leonida and use WAiNK It.
Reach 100 distinct locations; pair it with exploring for The Goodtime State.

trophies.guide: Knock out 50 Challenges — the objectives found under Progress > Challenges. Plenty of them finish by themselves as you play, so look at the list early and let the easy ones tick over on their own. Don't call it done at 50, though: 100% completion asks for 70 of the 80 Challenges, so keep chipping at the list after this trophy pops.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Open Progress > Challenges and work your way down the list.
Plenty finish on their own; push on to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Shake a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner at your side and get clear of the heat. A bank-vault job is the tidiest setup: vault jobs hand you a 4-star Wanted Level right away, so escaping one alongside your partner also banks progress toward Maximum Withdrawal. The trophy only triggers once you've fully left the red heat zone — clearing the flashing search area alone isn't enough — so keep driving until the heat has completely cleared.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Bring your partner along (possible once both characters are playable, from Chapter 2).
Trigger a 4-star Wanted Level — vault jobs grant one at once.
Escape until you are fully clear of the red heat zone.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Hit 3 shops in a row alongside your partner while keeping your Wanted Level alive throughout. Get your partner with you first, then rob three shops one after another with the police still on your tail — if the stars drop off and you're only sitting in the red heat zone, the chain is broken. Allow roughly 30 seconds for the trophy to pop after exiting the third shop before you consider a fourth.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Call your partner in first.
Rob three shops back-to-back while the Wanted Level stays live.
Wait around 30 seconds after leaving the third shop — the pop can lag.

trophies.guide: Log 100 discovered vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered once you've scanned it with the WAiNK app, so scan the traffic around you while driving and the tally rises with no detours needed. Don't stop at 100, though — 100% completion wants 200 of the 277 base models — keep scanning every new vehicle you spot.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Scan passing vehicles with the WAiNK app while you drive.
Hit 100 discovered, then carry on to 200 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies inside one activation of Combat Focus. That slow-motion aiming mode is triggered by pressing L3 and R3 while aiming. Find a cluster of gang enemies — the guards at an illegal operation are ideal — and bring an assault rifle so your shots land quickly. Adrenaline stretches Focus out, buying extra time to line up all five.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Locate a group of enemies — illegal-operation guards are a good pick.
Aim, then press L3 + R3 to activate Combat Focus.
Drop 5 enemies using an assault rifle before Focus runs out.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport without a schedule — by stealing a big passenger jet docked at a boarding bridge. Aircraft parked anywhere else on the airfield won't count; the jets at gates E3 and E4 are the ones that work. Climb into the cockpit, reverse out toward the runway and get airborne. The pop is delayed: head roughly 1 km away from the airport before it triggers. Save beforehand, since the police arrive quickly.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Save first, then head for VCIA gates E3 or E4.
Take a passenger plane that's docked at a boarding bridge.
Get airborne and fly roughly 1 km away from the airport.

trophies.guide: The description gives it away: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' points to climbing into a military tank. Look for tanks parked along the southern edge of Mile Zero Air Station — the base sits on an island at the map's far southwest corner. Save beforehand, climb in, then drive around and fire away until it pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Save first, then make your way to Mile Zero Air Station on the far southwest island.
Look for a Rhino stationed along the southern edge, climb aboard, then cruise around blasting the cannon until the trophy unlocks.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Pull off a jewelry store robbery without being spotted. Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, a Chapter 3 mission, hands you the Snap Gun and unlocks jewelry-store robberies — head for a store's locked back door and apply the Snap Gun to it. Forcing the door open by kicking it trips the alarm. Once you're in the back room, look for the note carrying the safe code, crack the safe open, and slip out unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City makes a solid target. If anyone catches sight of you, reload instead of pressing on.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to pick up the Snap Gun.
Apply the Snap Gun to a jewelry store's locked back door — kicking it in trips the alarm.
Inside, find the safe-code note, crack the safe, and slip out unseen; reload if spotted.

trophies.guide: Hit 5 bank vaults and get away clean. Vaults open up through the optional late-Chapter-4 mission That's Where The Money Is: shadow an armored security van as it heads to a large bank, then slip inside while the guard has the vault open. The bags are too many to haul solo, so take your partner along. A vault job hands you a 4-star Wanted Level right away — and escaping one with your partner beside you also ticks off Hot Together. All eight vaults are needed for the 100% checklist, so don't stop at five.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Run the late-Chapter-4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is to open up vaults.
Follow a security van to a bank, then slip inside while the guard has the vault open.
Take your partner — the bags are too many to carry alone — and escape. Hit 5 vaults, 8 for 100%.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and make your getaway. These trucks patrol the roads across the state — pull one over, grab its cargo and get away clean. As with Hot Together, the trophy only pops after you've left the red heat zone, not merely the flashing search area — stay on the move until the heat has fully cleared.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Spot an armored truck out on the roads and rob it.
Escape until you've fully left the red heat zone.

citation.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — the list tracks 52 areas. Drive, fly and walk into every corner of the map and the area counter fills in. Pair it with You WAiNKer! (WAiNK It at 100 locations) and Whip It Good (scan vehicles as you go) and three trophies progress on the same tour.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Visit every area of the map; the list tracks 52.
Pair the tour with WAiNK check-ins and vehicle scans.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit an illegal operation run by each of the nine gangs. A single hit per gang satisfies this trophy, while the 100% checklist calls for all 39 operations — so this one pops on the road to A Long Road. Illegal operations double as handy Gunslinger practice, since their guards bunch together nicely for Combat Focus.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Hit one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
Carry on past that: all 39 operations are needed for 100%.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — launch-week guides list this as one of five hidden trophies whose trigger is still unconfirmed, and the description is the only hint. The plain reading: find a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a view, order a cocktail and enjoy it. It may pop while you play normally, so don't grind for it — check the sources for a confirmed method as launch-week guides update.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: No confirmed method yet at launch — the description is the only hint.
Try a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach; check the cited source for updates.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — launch-week guides list this as one of five hidden trophies whose trigger is still unconfirmed. The plain reading is a classic GTA move: drive a car through a vehicle showroom's window and out the other side. It may pop while you play normally; check the cited source for a confirmed method as launch-week guides update.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: No confirmed method yet at launch — the description is the only hint.
The classic reading: smash a car out through a showroom window.
Check the cited source for a confirmed method.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: The Kolt & Associates alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you'll visit during Chapter 2. Pack Sticky Bombs. Grab all three key valuables: the luxury watch sitting in an office, the shotgun lying on a table, and what's inside the office safe, which you crack open with a Sticky Bomb. Then lose the police. Leaving something behind isn't a disaster — the operation returns later, so nothing here is missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Head to Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2, carrying Sticky Bombs.
Collect the three valuables: luxury watch, shotgun, and office safe contents — Sticky Bomb the safe open.
Lose the police; the operation comes back later if you miss anything.

trophies.guide: This hidden trophy is expected to pop once Jason and Lucia have both maxed out Strength. The 'partnership with mass appeal' in the description points to the two of them training side by side. Get a gym membership and work out with your partner there, since your partner trains right beside you. Push both characters to maximum Strength and the trophy should follow.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Get a gym membership, then work out with your partner at your side.
Take both Jason and Lucia to maximum Strength.

trophies.guide: This hidden trophy counts 500 actions that shift your Criminal Profile — robberies and fights both feed it, so it fills without any dedicated grind. Simply play the game as normal: rob shops, vaults and operations, pick fights, and watch the counter rise. It should pop by itself over the course of a normal trophy run.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Just play normally — robberies and fights both push the Criminal Profile counter up.
It fills by itself; no dedicated grind is needed.

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — launch-week guides list this as one of five hidden trophies whose trigger is still unconfirmed, and the description is the only hint. The plain reading is succeeding at something on a second attempt, after a first failure. It may pop while you play normally; check the cited source for a confirmed method as launch-week guides update.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: No confirmed method yet at launch — the description is the only hint.
Likely: succeed at something on a second try after failing once.
Check the cited source for a confirmed method.

trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — launch-week guides list this as one of five hidden trophies whose trigger is still unconfirmed. The description suggests witnessing something strange, an odd event or encounter out in Leonida. It may pop while you play normally; check the cited source for a confirmed method as launch-week guides update.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: No confirmed method yet at launch — the description is the only hint.
Likely: witness a strange event or encounter somewhere in Leonida.
Check the cited source for a confirmed method.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: No confirmed unlock method at launch — launch-week guides list this as one of five hidden trophies whose trigger is still unconfirmed. The plain reading: knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a melee drive-by. It may pop while you play normally; check the cited source for a confirmed method as launch-week guides update.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: No confirmed method yet at launch — the description is the only hint.
The plain reading: knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle.
Check the cited source for a confirmed method.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Make $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. You pick up Marked Bills on bank and payday loan jobs, then launder them by selling them on to your contacts. The $250,000 figure is a running total across the whole game, so it grows as you work vault and loan jobs — no one job has to be enormous.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Earn Marked Bills by running bank and payday loan jobs.
Sell them on to your contacts — laundered value counts toward the $250,000 total, cumulative.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so normal spending counts — weapons, clothes, food, car mods, everything. It fills naturally during a full run; if you are close at the end, a shopping spree closes the gap.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend across any shops; the $100,000 total is cumulative.
Top it up with a shopping spree if you are close at the end.

trophies.guide: Buy every one of the 8 garage properties. They're sold through the Vice City Real Estate app, which opens up after Daily Driver, a Chapter 2 mission. All eight together run about $160,000. Garages handed to you by the story don't count — only the eight you purchase yourself. Get the garages sorted before you start registering vehicles for On the Spot, because every registered car takes up a free garage space.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Open up the Vice City Real Estate app by finishing Daily Driver in Chapter 2.
Buy all 8 garages — about $160,000 in total; story-gifted garages don't count.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Put 10 vehicles on the books with the Scooter Bros app. Moses, a Chapter 2 mission, opens the app up: bring a stolen car to Moses, pick Respray, then Register. Starting in Chapter 3, cars can also be registered at Pay 'n' Spray using a standard tracker. Every car takes a free garage space, so sort the garages out first and stick to cheap cars.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Unlock the Scooter Bros app via the mission Moses in Chapter 2.
Bring stolen cars to Moses — Respray, then Register — until you've done 10 vehicles.
Buy garages first; every registered car needs a free space.
